articles.title: Warren Buffett sounds alarm as stock market warning returns for only second time in 155 years
articles.content: Warren Buffett’s caution comes as the S&P 500’s CAPE ratio approaches levels seen only during periods of extreme valuations. While elevated readings can signal weaker long-term returns, they do not predict near-term crashes. Buffett’s investment philosophy instead emphasises economic moats, durable cash flows and businesses capable of compounding across market cycles.

articles.title: BoJ has room to accelerate rate hikes as inflation pressures build: Report
articles.content: Japan is witnessing a surge in underlying inflation, driven by escalating producer prices and wage growth. While government subsidies are currently easing the consumer burden from rising energy costs, inflation expectations continue to climb, indicating a potential wage-price spiral. Analysts predict that the Bank of Japan could implement a twenty-five basis points rate increase in 2026, with more hikes anticipated in 2027, possibly reaching 1.75%.
